timeline.author: iverase

timeline.body:
This aggregator does not implement needScore() and therefore it always return false as it cannot have sub-aggregations. The issue is that if it contains a script that needs scores, then the assumption is wrong. Note that this test has starting failing due to work on https://github.com/apache/lucene-solr/pull/1834

closes #62438
Note that this construct seems to be used by all `NumericMetricsAggregator`, I winder if we can move it to the parent class?
